text.title: User Story Mapping Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the artefact this methodology produces, plus one valid and one invalid example, and a closed list of forbidden patterns the validator must reject.

list.pattern: missing any required field — violates the contract
a release slice that does not touch every backbone activity — violates r7-full-backbone-slices

example.code: { "artefact_id": "user-story-mapping-example", "version": "1.0.0", "last_reviewed": "2026-05-23", "persona": "persona value", "backbone": [ "Sign up", "Create Project", "Invite Teammate", "Track Task", "Close Project" ], "tasks": [ "magic-link signup", "blank project", "email invite", "plain task list", "one-click close" ], "walking_skeleton": [ "magic-link signup", "blank project", "email invite", "plain task list", "one-click close" ], "release_slices": [ "walking-skeleton", "release-1", "later" ], "owner": "@solo-founder" }
example.note: Minimum viable conformant output — every required field present, no forbidden pattern matched.
Invalid — required fields missing or forbidden patterns matched (e.g. semver violation).
